Ava Lin: Bridgeway Health (renewal in ~7w) asked for a 60m enablement office hour focused on onboarding checklist + alert tuning. Can we run a single session that covers EMEA/APAC overlap?
Mark Evans: I can do a metrics + alerts walkthrough. Prefer 15:00-16:00 UTC to hit late EMEA/early APAC.
Jana Park: Alternative 13:30-14:30 UTC would be better for our CS hosts. Can we quick poll?
Ava Lin: Customer prefers later window. Let's poll but bias to 15:00.
Jana Park: Poll posted: `poll: ["13:30-14:30 UTC","15:00-16:00 UTC"]` closing in 1h. Will provision recording and a shared folder.
Remi (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: Bridgeway Onboarding Office Hour  provisional on CS calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/bridgeway-oohr
Mark Evans: Agenda: 10m intros + 30m alert tuning/demo + 20m Q&A/renewal pulse. I'll prep dashboard screenshots and a 1-page tuning checklist.
Ava Lin: Prework: attendee list, 1-min pre-survey, and sample alert config. Also shared feedback form for renewal signals: https://forms.gle/redwood-bridgeway-feedback (questions: "confidence now" and "top open risk").
Remi (calendar-bot): Poll closed  selected `15:00-16:00 UTC`. Event confirmed; invites sent; recording enabled; channel created: #bridgeway-onboard-oh.
Jana Park: I'll post final agenda + folder link in the new channel. Moving follow-ups there and closing this scheduling thread.
